summary_md: **MMLA ([@MMLA_org](https://x.com/MMLA_org/status/2116169427670712783))** releases **MMLA-Orbit-1B**, its first 1B-class model with adaptive policy state, versioned task memory and a runtime that proposes, tests and conditionally installs memory-management rules ([MMLA-ORG/MMLA-Orbit-1B](https://huggingface.co/MMLA-ORG/MMLA-Orbit-1B), [MMLA-org/MMLA-RSI](https://github.com/MMLA-org/MMLA-RSI)).
relevance: Small self-modifying-memory model to experiment with locally.
